source.title: dogbark.wav

source.downloadKind: Publicly linked high-quality MP3 preview; original WAV download requires login and was not used.
source.description: This is my neighbors Boston terrier barking at me

processing.selection: First individual bark from the recording; excludes the second bark.
processing.resampling: Decoded/downmixed to mono at 22050 Hz by miniaudio.
processing.dcRemoval: Subtract clip sum divided by sum of a zero-ended squared-sine weight, multiplied by that weight.
processing.otherEdits: No synthesized animal audio or added sound; source recording only.
